rdf:Description.skos:description: This ticket covers the preservation of the custom exception classes from `draw_io_parser.py`. These exceptions are well-defined and should be moved to the new `gbad_core/drawio.py` module to maintain robust error handling.
rdf:Description.skos:scopeNote:
**Relevant Code Snippets:** ```python class NothingToParseException(Exception): """ Can be thrown when calling the constructor of the DrawIOXMLTree class if the passed-in XML appears to define an empty graph """
class NotInKnownException(Exception): """ Can be thrown if an arrow has a label which does not correspond to an object or datatype property in RiC-O, and if it has been specified that this is not to be permitted """ # ... and so on for all other custom exceptions ```
rdf:Description.skos:changeNote: **Implementation Plan:** 1. **Create `gbad_core/exceptions.py`:** - Create a new file `gbad_core/exceptions.py` to house all custom exceptions for the library. 2. **Move Exception Classes:** - Move the class definitions for all custom exceptions from `draw_io_parser.py` to the new `gbad_core/exceptions.py` module. - Create a base exception class, `GBADException`, and have all other exceptions inherit from it. 3. **Update `gbad_core/drawio.py`:** - Import the custom exceptions from `gbad_core.exceptions`. - Update the `DrawIOParser` class and its methods to raise these exceptions where appropriate.
